title: New type of sand wedge polygons in the salt cemented soils of the hyper-arid Atacama Desert
text:
Bibliographic record (Crossref metadata, not the paper's full text): New type of sand wedge polygons in the salt cemented soils of the hyper-arid Atacama Desert.

Authors: Christof Sager, Alessandro Airo, Felix L. Arens, Dirk Schulze-Makuch.

Published in Geomorphology, volume 373, pages 107481 (2021), publisher Elsevier BV. DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.geomorph.2020.107481.

This record describes what the publication is about; the peer-reviewed full text is behind the DOI and was not ingested.
